why: The Chromium of the app's Electron (45.2.3 ships Chromium 156.0.8078.80, per releases.electronjs.org), which Chrome for Testing publishes exactly, so the browser where no app runs is the app's engine. Move it with each Electron upgrade, or ahead of Electron for a security fix (say which fix here). Each archive's bytes and SHA-256 were computed from the download, not taken from the server, and match spike S7's; `tree` is the digest of the unpacked tree (install.ts's treeDigestOfArchive), which a reused install is checked against before each launch.
